BrochureContent.Content:
A fantastic opportunity to acquire this beautifully presented four-bedroom detached bungalow, ideally situated on the highly sought-after area of Convent Road, Ballaghaderreen, Co. Roscommon.

Presented to the market in excellent turnkey condition, this impressive family home offers generous, well-proportioned accommodation combined with wonderful outdoor space. 

Its enviable location is within easy walking distance of Ballaghaderreen town centre, with a host of amenities close by including shops, schools, sporting facilities and a range of service providers.

The well-appointed accommodation comprises:
•A welcoming Entrance Hall with attractive wood flooring.
•A bright and spacious Sitting Room featuring ceiling coving, wood flooring and a beautiful feature fireplace, with feature arch doors leading through to the kitchen/diner.
•A fully fitted Kitchen/Diner with stove and double doors opening onto the garden. Velux windows flood the room with natural light, creating a bright and inviting space.
•A separate Utility Room.
•Four generous double bedrooms, with the principal bedroom benefiting from an Ensuite.
•A Family Bathroom.
•A large Office, with patio doors providing direct access to the front of the property.

Externally, the property benefits from ample off-street parking, a large private garden to include a tree house and an extensive paved patio area offering an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing. 

The property benefits from newly installed Smartfence composite boundary fencing and also included is a purpose built steel utility shed. 

Located on a corner site offering excellent privacy, the property also benefits from two separate access points, with access available from two different roads.

Additional features include mains services, oil-fired central heating and broadband availability from several providers. 

This is a superb home that combines generous living space, privacy and convenience with the considerable benefit of single-level living. 

Presented in excellent condition throughout, it is ideally suited to families, those looking to downsize without compromising on space, or anyone seeking a ready-to-move-into home.

Ballaghaderreen is well served by regular bus services to both Dublin and Ballina, while Local Link services provide connections to Sligo several times daily. Ireland West Airport approximately a 20-minute drive away.

Homes of this calibre and in such a desirable location rarely come to the market. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, space and excellent setting this fine property has to offer.

Key Features
•Four-bedroom detached bungalow
•Turnkey condition throughout
•Enviable location of Convent Road, Ballaghaderreen, Co. Roscommon.
•Four generous double bedrooms
•Ensuite to one bedroom
•Spacious sitting room with feature fireplace
•Fully fitted kitchen/diner with stove & Velux window flooding the space in natural light
•Double doors to garden and large paved patio area
•Separate utility room
•Family bathroom
•Oil-fired central heating
•Mains services
•Off-street parking
•Large private garden
•Corner Site Offering Excellent Privacy
•Two Access Points from two separate roads
•Broadband available from several providers
•Walking distance of Ballaghaderreen town
